score_semantics: Source-contract confidence only; not parcel-result or numeric elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
verified_facts: Independent ground-truth points are surveyed on flat unambiguous surfaces
Each ground-truth point is reported at +/-3cm RMSE accuracy
Environment Agency LIDAR surveys must report less than +/-15cm RMSE and 10cm standard-deviation and random-error thresholds to pass quality control
The service is referenced to EPSG:27700
semantic_limits: Ground-truth points are survey-level quality evidence, not parcel elevation samples
A nearby control point cannot replace exact polygon raster sampling
Specific survey ground-truth results may require publisher contact

candidates.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
verified_facts: The archive contains high-accuracy x, y and z points with component attributes
Point returns are classified into ground and surface-object classes
Point clouds can support bespoke terrain, canopy-height and intensity raster products
Time-stamped DTM and DSM products are derived from point-cloud surveys
semantic_limits: A matching point cloud may not exist for every historic DTM or DSM because of archive history
Point classification must be checked before any bespoke raster is accepted
Point-cloud QA does not replace exact HMLR polygon identity

candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme
verified_facts: The programme provides 1m elevation coverage for England
Phase 1 divided England into 302 survey blocks captured during winter seasons from 2017 to 2023
Repeat blocks receive incrementing phase numbers
Survey products are published through the Defra survey portal on an ongoing quarterly basis
semantic_limits: There is no stated rolling recapture plan for every Phase 1 block
The newest survey date varies by location
Programme coverage does not itself prove which raster tile was sampled

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Technical Specification
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 is a bare-earth digital terrain model
The product is supplied as gridded heights and contours
It is designed as a mid-resolution product interoperable with large-scale Ordnance Survey data
Technical documentation defines formats for software processing
semantic_limits: The 5m product remains secondary to suitable Environment Agency LiDAR
Interpolation and post spacing limit parcel-edge sensitivity
Product access and licensing must be satisfied before automated use

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Grid Data
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 grid values are supplied in ASCII with accompanying GML metadata
Each height value is calculated from the centre of its pixel
Each pixel is 50m by 50m
A 10km tile contains 200 grid pixels per row
semantic_limits: Cell-centre values must not be represented as parcel-edge measurements
The 50m grid is too coarse for primary parcel-scale height difference
Use is limited to broad-scale consistency and gross-outlier checks
